games.name: Brainrot Stairs
games.desc:
WILL YOU SURVIVE BOMBINI GUSINI?!?

Every round, one player becomes the Dropper, standing above the stairs with one job: Throw Italian brainrot creatures down the stairs to knock everyone off!

The rest? They gotta climb to the top without getting flung by a falling tung tung sahur.


 🎮 How to Play:

* One player is picked as the Dropper each round.
* The Dropper throws brainrot creatures down the stairs!
* Everyone else runs, jumps, and dodges their way to the top.
* First to reach the top wins the round!

CONTROLS (PC):
- M to open Menu.

RACE CONTROLS (PC):
- Press Space to Sprint.
- When Sprinting, Hold Space then Release at the right Timing to Spurt.
- W,A,S,D to Change Direction/Turn.

CONSOLE CONTROLS:
- Press A to Sprint
- When Sprinting, Hold A then Release at the right Timing to Spurt.

Reroll your Trait at Trait Research in Menu.
It's Recommended to check your Stats to learn how your Trait Abilities Work.

Playtest Feature: You get free 3 Licenses at the Start, Participate in a Race or Predict other Player to earn License.
